_meta.notes: Cover is the '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' form filed for the 2024 cycle (Seven days before a primary election, signed 6/18/24). No county schedule pages exist in the document: pp.3-10 are the filer's own regenerated replicas of the county grid, headed 'Candidate / Sheila Srivastava / 06/18/2024' and footed 'Page N of 7' (A) / 'Page 1 of 1' (B) — attachment-is-the-schedule. Black bar over the Complete Mailing Address column on every Schedule A page: donor city/state redacted at source throughout; occupation column survives the bar. Schedule B has no address column. A row 79 (p6) occupation reads 'UnitedHealth Grouo' — printed filer typo, kept verbatim. The four In-Kind contributions (Jan Coleman 200, Root'd Café 709, Active Zen 216, Dawnell Reynolds 50) are mirrored as In-Kind expenditures on Schedule B (EVENTS).
